summary.text: John Bartholomew, a Democrat from Hartland, has represented Windsor-1 in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2011.
He is vice chair of the House Committee on Agriculture, Food Resiliency, and Forestry and sits on the House Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: Bartholomew was born in Philadelphia and has lived in Hartland since 2005, according to his House biography.
He studied zoology and botany at the University of Oklahoma and earned a BS in agriculture and a Doctor of Veterinary Medicine from Oklahoma State University.

He is a retired veterinarian, a former chief of the Research Animal Management Branch of the National Institute of Child Health and Human Development at the National Institutes of Health, and a retired Captain in the U.S. Public Health Service.
He is a member of the University of Vermont Board of Trustees.
